reply_text:
I saved the draft to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) and replied to Anselm in the direct message. Nothing has been sent; the draft is waiting for someone to send it.

- **Approval:** Quarrendon Freight Lines is Dana's account on the North team. Hollis leads the Central team, so a per-seat rate would normally need sign-off before going to them. Anselm is the CFO, one of the two people who can give that sign-off, and his message counted as approval. Hollis's address is on pemberline.com, so Ruth Calloway's approval wasn't needed either.
- **The draft:** The subject is "Quarrendon Freight Lines: proposed 2027 per-seat rate". The body gives $2,356 per seat, says the figure comes from Dana, says Anselm approved sharing it, and asks Hollis to keep it internal.
- **The figure isn't checked:** I didn't compare $2,356 against any file or note, so it's exactly what Dana told Anselm. I told Anselm that in my reply.

GBrain had operational notes on the account but no 2027 rate. Its search was running keyword-only, so that doesn't prove the rate isn't recorded anywhere.
